answers.core: There is no way to do drawing and GPU processing in the same way that particles do.
answers.workaround: While these things could be achieved with multimeshes instead, there is a difference on where on hardware the logic executes: the computation for whatever is in instance_custom for multimeshes has to happen on CPU, while on particles it all happens on GPU instead.

title: Add an option for immortal (infinite lifetime) particles
